rules.description: Use of a non-constant-time verification routine to check the value of an HTTP header, possibly allowing a timing attack to infer the header's expected value.

rules.cwe_name: Download of Code Without Integrity Check
rules.description: Enabling allowRunningInsecureContent can allow remote code execution.
Using indexOf to implement endsWith functionality is error-prone if the -1 case is not explicitly handled.
An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.
If a conditional expression always evaluates to true or always evaluates to false, this suggests incomplete code or a logic error.
Assigning to a property of a primitive value has no effect and may trigger a runtime error.
A remote endpoint identifier is read from an HTTP header. Attackers can modify the value of the identifier to forge the client ip.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
rules.description: Comparing different kinds of HTTP request data may be a symptom of an insufficient security check.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.
If an object literal has two properties with the same name, the second property overwrites the first one, which makes the code hard to understand and error-prone.
